title: West Africa Daily Intelligence Brief
executive_summary: Today's West Africa briefing is shaped primarily by politics, economy and security. Significant developments are concentrated in Senegal, Niger, Sierra Leone, Côte d'Ivoire. Security pressures remain an important source of political and humanitarian risk; while economic policy and market conditions continue to influence investor confidence and household welfare.

learning.title: Why infrastructure affects industrial growth
learning.description: Reliable electricity, roads, railways and ports reduce production and trading costs. Weak infrastructure can therefore limit manufacturing growth even where labour and natural resources are available.

methodology: Stories are collected from public Google News RSS searches, classified using keyword rules, filtered for near-duplicates and ranked using source quality, recency and political-risk relevance.
